activity_summary: You read the Rose bill at home. The title was The Seven Days of the Week, at two. There was no sum on it. You did not cross. Your afternoon was the Theatre, by the fields.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the title and set out for the Theatre by the fields.
